item.description: Plant-based food is hot. Maybe you’ve thought about investing in it, either just because you think such an investment might yield a good return down the road, and/or because you want your investments to align with your values of sustainability, health and compassion for animals. item.title: Interview with Humane Hancock - The Vegan Strategist
item.description: Not so long ago, activist, podcaster and filmmaker Jack Hancock-Fairs did this interview with me. We talked about the state and the possibilities for improvement for animal activism, individual vs. institutional change, communication, avoiding burnout as an activist, wild animal suffering, and other topics.

item.title: Who we eat - The Vegan Strategist
item.description: German/French tv channel ARTE produced an excellent five part documentary series called “Who we eat: the end of meat”. item.title: Animal Activism between Despair and Hope - The Vegan Strategist
item.description: The intention behind this presentation, given at the CARE conference in 2022, is to both recognize the negative feelings activists may sometimes feel, as well as to inspire them to keep going. I talk about my own doubts and despair, but show that there are good reasons to be optimistic about humanity, our movement, and […]

item.title: An interview with Peter Singer - The Vegan Strategist
item.description: This is an interview I hosted with Peter Singer at the CARE Conference 2022 in Warsaw. We discussed the state of the animal rights movement, what we need more and less of, how the future looks, what he changed his mind about, career options, effective altruism, intersectionality, how Peter Singer feels and other topics.
